title: Office process spawns PowerShell with encoded command
description: Detects Office child process launching PowerShell with encoded command flags.

query.expression: selection: ParentImage|endswith: ['\WINWORD.EXE','\EXCEL.EXE','\POWERPNT.EXE'] and Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe' and CommandLine|contains: [' -enc ',' -encodedcommand ']
